exec: pm.test("Server computed end time", () => { pm.expect((new Date(j.endTime)-new Date(j.startTime))/60000).to.eql(120); pm.expect(j.showtimeStatus).to.eql("SCHEDULED"); });

item.name: 5.3 Allow same time in other room

exec: pm.test("All forty seats available", () => { pm.expect(j.totalSeats).to.eql(40); pm.expect(j.availableSeats).to.eql(40); pm.expect(j.bookedSeats).to.be.empty; });

pm.test("Confirmed tickets and server price", () => { pm.expect(j.bookingStatus).to.eql("CONFIRMED"); pm.expect(j.details.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(Number(j.totalPrice)).to.eql(190000); pm.expect(j.details.reduce((s,d)=>s+Number(d.price),0)).to.eql(Number(j.totalPrice)); pm.expect(j.details[0].movieTitle).to.eql("Hành Trình Phương Nam"); });

item.name: 7.7 Released seat can be booked again

exec: pm.test("Zero report totals", () => { pm.expect(j.totalBookings).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.totalTickets).to.eql(0); pm.expect(Number(j.totalRevenue)).to.eql(0); pm.expect(j.revenueByMovie).to.be.empty; });
